blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_ai.question: Do AI Overviews reduce my clicks?
blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_ai.answer: For informational queries, yes — CTR commonly drops. Being cited preserves brand visibility and captures the users who click through for depth.

blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_i_.question: Can I opt out of AI Overviews?
blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_i_.answer: You can block Google-Extended or use nosnippet directives, but blocking removes your citation opportunity while your competitors keep theirs.

blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_sc.question: Does schema guarantee an Overview citation?
blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_sc.answer: No. Schema helps Google parse your content reliably, but selection depends on relevance, authority and clarity of the passage.

blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_fa.question: How fast can changes take effect?
blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_fa.answer: Overview citation sets refresh frequently; well-structured updates on already-ranking pages can be reflected within two to six weeks.

blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_ov.question: Do Overviews cite small sites?
blog_google_ai_overviews_optimization_ov.answer: Yes, when the page is the clearest answer for a specific niche query. Specificity beats domain size on long-tail topics.
